page.layout: One bookplate, centred on the page: a circular emblem with a book and the legend around it, and a panel below with the owner's inscription. Handwriting above and below the plate is not transcribed.
page.notes: The bookplate is printed matter and is transcribed. Excluded as handwriting: "Thorp, July, 1898." at the top, the pencilled "9" and "8" by the tape, the "a/r" note top left, the mark "Xe" on the plate's upper right, and the pencilled "L127" bottom left. The typed slip "Ulrich Middeldorf" at the foot is an owner or dealer label pasted on the page; it is not transcribed here. On the book in the emblem, "LIBE" and "R·SV" are split across lines as drawn, and the final "M·" is part of the same legend (LIBER SVM). Reading is from the scan at reduced size, so the small letters are not certain.
